title: Programmable Heisenberg-limit sensor from a nonlinear quantum energy pump
summary: We introduce a programmable Heisenberg-limited bosonic quantum sensor based on a nonlinear quantum energy pump, implemented with a Kerr-nonlinear resonator coupled to multiple high-Q microwave terminal resonators. For parameter estimation encoded in an arbitrary number-conserving Hamiltonian acting on the terminal modes, we analytically construct optimal sensing protocols that attain the maximal quantum Fisher information, including initial-state loading, probe preparation, and readout.
